input.command:
mkdir -p /root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts && cat > /root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_k_ablation.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# K-ablation for exp-002 (sica_k_sensitivity_14b)
# 60 problems (30 PW + 30 FOLIO), K={6,8,11,12,16,20}
# K=11: odd-K no tie; K=12: baseline (matches D012)
set -e
cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

RESULTS_DIR="results/k_ablation"
mkdir -p "$RESULTS_DIR"

PW_DATA="data/proofwriter_30.json"
FOLIO_DATA="data/folio_30.json"

for K in 6 8 11 12 16 20; do
    echo "=== Running K=$K at $(date) ==="
    python3 run_full_mvp.py \
        --mode vllm \
        --k $K \
        --temperature 0.7 \
        --max-tokens 4096 \
        --pw-data "$PW_DATA" \
        --folio-data "$FOLIO_DATA" \
        --math-data data/empty.json \
        --output "$RESULTS_DIR/k${K}_results.json" \
        --save-intermediates \
        --seed 42
    echo "=== K=$K done at $(date) ==="
done

echo "K_ABLATION_DONE"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_k_ablation.sh
